title: Change The Root Of A Binary Tree
description: Given a node of a binary tree, reroot the tree such that the given node becomes the new root.

steps.note: Initialize starting at the node to be rerooted (Node 2).
Disconnect Node 2 from its parent (Node 1) and flip the pointer structure.
Node 2 is now the root, updating parent pointers for the old root (Node 1).
Finalizing structural update to ensure Node 1 is a child of Node 2.
